What I did.

  1. Designed the M&E and results framework for the 5-year operation of the DSIP project.

The assignment.

Four components: institutional support for sanitation service delivery; sewerage and wastewater treatment; non-network sanitation in the Pagla STP area where sewers are not feasible; and project implementation and management support to establish a Project Management Unit at DWASA.
